messages:
Rhea: ping team 10 HarborView day0. Customer asks: HSM-backed CMKs for audit logs, strict assume-role for cross-account delivery, and egress allowlist for their SIEM. tagging for blockers and renewal risk. @Kofi @Anika
Kofi: understood. HSM CMK supported but we need their CloudHSM cluster id + attestation. Also confirm they want automatic rotation and what cadence.
harbor-it: rotation every 120 days, retention 3 years, bucket SSE-KMS with their key. We'll provide cluster id this afternoon.
Anika: ok. We'll require key policy that limits kms:Decrypt to our forwarder role and their VPC endpoint. I'll post a sanitized example after lunch.
Kofi: for cross-account delivery we recommend a role with narrow trust and PutObject / PutRecord permissions only. Will include Terraform snippet.
Rhea: networking note 10 egress only to collector IPs 18.142.22.16/28 over 443. They ask about mutual TLS for shipper.
Anika: hosted forwarder uses strict TLS; on-prem shipper supports mutual TLS. Add to runbook which mode they plan.
harbor-it: we'll use hosted. Need confirmation that SSE-KMS with customer CMK is supported for S3 delivery.
Anika: yes. Need bucket ARN + KMS key ARN and ensure role has s3:PutObject and kms:Encrypt permissions.
Rhea: renewal-risk rule: if >2 infra blockers at EOD escalate to AM for credit discussion. current blockers?
Kofi: blockers: 1) attestation doc pending, 2) S3 bucket policy not applied yet, 3) change window needed for firewall rule. that's 3 -> flagging risk.
harbor-it: attestation inbound by 1500 PT. S3 change queued. Firewall change earliest tomorrow morning.
Kofi: action items:
- Kofi: terraform assume-role + minimal policy (ETA today 4pm)
- Anika: sanitized KMS policy + tag requirement note (ETA tomorrow)
- Rhea: schedule enablement call and note renewal risk in CRM
ops-bot: runbook created: https://redwood.company/runbooks/harborview-onboard. Status: KMS: AWAITING-ATTESTATION, IAM: TEMPLATE-PREP, NETWORK: CHANGE-PENDING
Rhea: capture feedback for post-onboard: clarity of HSM instructions, speed of S3 policy assistance, firewall change coordination. Add any items.
Anika: suggest we add a pre-filled S3 bucket policy to accelerate cutover (internal action).
Kofi: if attestation delayed past EOD escalate to security PM.
Rhea: leaving thread open. ping me if anything slips. thanks :thumbsup:
